scope: Dispatch freshness after PO/TO linking, groups, splits, ungrouping, further splits and CO changes
setup: Existing Node, fast-check, Playwright, ESLint and isolated bounded Compose tools; no new dependencies, commits, production writes or data migrations.
behaviors: Fresh targeted reads bypass the asynchronous catalog and resolve the requested identity.
Affected order references and related group/split/CO cards refresh even outside the active browse page.
A read started before a local mutation or plan switch cannot apply afterward; overlapping requests keep the newest result.
An unchanged compact card preserves hydrated cargo and nested details; a changed card requires fresh detail before planning.
Authoritative nested group details replace outdated operational fields while local group membership and active driver evidence remain protected.
Further split returns and adopts a matching revision and digest; the subsequent save is accepted.
Catalog completion notifies connected Dispatch clients without recursively queuing another catalog refresh.
Order hydration begins on hover/focus and is coalesced, reducing the need to retry dragging.
Refresh failures are visible and do not clear the board, overwrite an open link draft, or silently unlock an unverifiable plan.
After a temporary bootstrap failure, idle polling retries a complete verified snapshot; unsaved or pending mutations block this recovery.
A slow browse page cannot overwrite a more recent targeted response for the same order.
Affected cards on another plan date refresh after group and split plan events.
A compact catalog card with a different content hash is verified against direct local data before it can replace hydrated details, even when the catalog request starts after the mutation.

behaviors.name: search-pagination-and-legacy-catalog-lag
behaviors.given: A link has completed and full details are verified
behaviors.when: Search, its next page, or the legacy feed returns an older compact card
behaviors.then: Direct verification retains the committed details

behaviors.name: data-clear-pending-read
behaviors.given: An order detail request is in flight
behaviors.when: Operational order data is cleared before that request returns
behaviors.then: The old response cannot restore the removed card

behaviors.name: http-refresh-identities
behaviors.given: A targeted mutation or further split succeeds
behaviors.when: Its acknowledgement and event are published
behaviors.then: Full details carry a matching signature and events identify the replacement orders

behaviors.name: full-day-playwright-replay
behaviors.given: A fresh isolated application database and two real browser sessions
behaviors.when: A compressed dispatch day performs PO/TO linking and unlinking, split and further split, grouping and ungrouping, unsplit, CO creation/cancellation, drag/drop, undo/redo, saves, reload and confirmation
behaviors.then: Every action persists correctly, quantities are conserved, both sessions converge, retired identities stay retired, and the final plan can be reopened from storage

behaviors.name: immediate-selection-actions
behaviors.given: The dispatcher selects a different order
behaviors.when: An order action is clicked before the delayed full render
behaviors.then: The action targets the newly selected order immediately

behaviors.name: human-action-latency
behaviors.given: The full-day replay uses actual clicks, typed references and drag gestures
behaviors.when: Each page load, search, selection, link, unlink, split, group, CO, drag and save completes
behaviors.then: Its response wait is recorded separately from typing or dragging, every wait over 1500 ms is marked slow even when functionally successful, and failed actions retain their evidence

behaviors.name: retired-assignment-cache
behaviors.given: A previously assigned group is ungrouped or another derived order is retired
behaviors.then: Its old assignment evidence cannot resolve the retired identity, while unretired child evidence remains available

behaviors.name: new-day-observer-plan-discovery
behaviors.given: A browser opens a day before its first plan exists
behaviors.when: A same-day plan event announces creation by another dispatcher
behaviors.then: The browser loads the new verified snapshot and follows future revisions, without replacing a local unsaved draft
behaviors.test: dispatch-freshness.browser.test.mjs: empty day and unsaved draft; full-day replay second browser

behaviors.name: backend-and-both-browsers-without-manual-refresh
behaviors.given: Two real browser sessions and fresh reads from the isolated application's PostgreSQL-backed endpoints
behaviors.when: PO or TO links change, orders split or further split, groups change, COs change, a drag autosaves, or the plan saves or confirms
behaviors.then: Operational order content including nested group children, retired identities, and saved plan revision, digest and load stops match both browsers without any manual refresh or intervening Save in an order-mutation check; timings share the initiating action's clock and mark convergence over 1500 ms slow

behaviors.name: group-relationship-pickups-survive-rental-projection
behaviors.given: A grouped sales order has committed PO or TO pickups and children based at yard 3445
behaviors.when: The backend applies rental-order decoration to fresh dispatch details
behaviors.then: Ordinary SO groups retain their pickup summary and source address; actual rental groups move their base to 3445 while retaining linked PO/TO pickups, so the backend and browser agree
behaviors.test: dispatch-freshness-sor.test.js and full-day group PO link/unlink consistency

behaviors.name: selection-repaint-preserves-active-drag
behaviors.given: The dispatcher begins dragging immediately after selecting an order
behaviors.when: The delayed selection repaint would run while the pointer is held
behaviors.then: The drag source remains mounted and the drop can complete without a second attempt

failureModel.derived identity resurrection or quantit: Group/split/CO regression suites and retirement assertions
failureModel.revision without matching content digest: Isolated database mutation followed by fenced save
failureModel.refresh storm or slow drag: Coalescing, bounded concurrency and browser request-count checks
failureModel.driver history or unsaved edits overwrit: Existing save, active evidence and CO preservation suites
